description: Row ID -> test case traceability for one process area / decision-log range. Produced by test-case-design; read by the realize-deploy Q-gate.

row_id_range.description: The decision-log Row ID range this matrix covers, cited verbatim.

classification.description: 'Workaround' mirrors fit-to-standard's own third decision-log state (proposed workaround, not yet resolved to Standard or Delta) - a row in this state still gets a coverage-matrix entry, not a forced guess at which of the other two it 'really' is.

techniques_used.description: More than one entry is expected, not exceptional, when a row's shape genuinely matches more than one technique (see test-design-techniques.md's tie-break test) - don't collapse to one to make this field look tidier than the row actually is.

test_case_ids.description: TS-<process-slug>-NN, per test-script-template.md. Empty array means a zero-coverage gap - must appear in the top-level 'gaps' list, never silently absent. NOT the same signal as classification=Workaround, which can have a non-empty array here and still need an 'unresolved_classifications' entry - the two lists track different open items and a row can appear in either, both, or neither.

caveats.description: A specific unverified/provisional claim this row's coverage rests on, distinct from the coarse status above (convention: docs/skill-design-conventions.md #4) - e.g. 'seed-only, design-record pending' or 'derived from a Draft decision log, pending session confirmation'. Never bury this in notes where a reader skimming only the status column would miss it.

gaps.description: Zero-coverage rows only. A Workaround row with non-empty test_case_ids does not belong here - see unresolved_classifications.

unresolved_classifications.description: Every classification=Workaround row, regardless of test_case_ids. Distinct from gaps: the open item here is that fit-to-standard hasn't resolved Standard vs Delta, never a statement about missing test coverage. A row can appear in both this array and gaps (if it also has zero cases) - that is two genuinely separate open items, not a duplicate.

test_case_ids.description: Copy of coverage[].test_case_ids for this row - may be non-empty.
